title: Image and video requests get sturdier
summary:
A debugging day for image, video, and text models, with cleaner chat errors and some account and showcase upkeep.

LTX-2 video requests now use a reachable HTTPS route and retry when a completed job’s file is not ready yet. Nova Canvas image requests avoid a handler unsupported by Cloudflare Workers. Image and video errors also preserve upstream status and response details, making failed requests easier to diagnose.

`mistral` now routes to Azure Foundry’s `mistral-small-2503` after timeouts on its previous route. This changes the underlying model from Mistral Small 3.2 to 3.1; new 3.1 aliases were added, while existing 3.2 aliases still resolve but now point to 3.1.

The chat API now drops invalid optional names from system, user, and assistant messages before sending requests upstream. Invalid tool and function names receive a local 400 instead, since silently changing those names would change their meaning.

highlights.title: Mistral changes route
highlights.text: `mistral` now uses Mistral Small 3.1 through Azure Foundry instead of the route that was timing out. You can also request it with `mistral-small-3.1` or `mistral-small-2503`; existing 3.2 aliases now resolve to 3.1. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
